title: Part Thirty-Five: Two Tests, One Result

sections.brief: Urbit 2024–25 and DOGE 2025–26 as two live tests of the CEO-sovereign idea in the loose sense (authority without title, in a crisis, under a body above); caveats up front (neither tests neocameralism as written; DOGE not Yarvin's, rhyme not provenance; his 'too much libertarian DNA' and 'barely scratching the surface'); promises (wartime CEO/Horowitz; $2T, 'outside volunteers', 'bureaucracy', 'maximally transparent', Fisher declaration); what happened (board fight, Senate vote 9 Oct 2025, founder leaves; GAO-26-108615, 'No, we didn't' under oath, -256k, 4 Jul 2026 end, no report); who checked it (galaxy quorum 64/majority 129, 185/256 insiders, planets no vote; AFGE v. OPM Privacy Act ruling, FOIA cert, SCOTUS SSA stay cutting the other way, GAO systems report, dividend refused vs $9bn rescission act of 24 Jul 2025, the president); what lasted (EO 14410 ~8,000, PEER v. Trump no injunction); the one result and two counter-readings (Yarvin's 'not a real test'; checks partial and late); Book VI worst-case test across de31–de33 (Slaughter, ICE $75bn, Guard LA and D.C. to 2029, Trump v. Illinois interim 23 Dec 2025 and 31 Dec withdrawal, IEEPA tariffs struck), linking de31/de32 ids, de40, de34. Figures: compare, compare, compare
